sentences.text:
The State Of Haryana vs M/S Pranav Pooja Traders Processors
And ... on 15 February, 2024
Bench: Bela M. Trivedi, Pankaj Mithal
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Civil Appeal No. Of 2024
 (Arising out of Slp (C) No.8417 of 2019)
 State Of Haryana & Ors. App
 Versus
 M/S. Pranav Pooja Traders
 Processors & Manufactures Resp
 O R D E R
1. Leave granted.

2. The impugned order dated 13-11-2017 passed by the High Court of Punjab and Haryana at
Chandigarh, whereby the Civil Writ Petition No.10972 of 2016 filed by the respondent  herein
was allowed, is under challenge before this Court.

3. Having heard the learned A.A.G. for the appellants and the learned counsel for the sole respondent and carefully perusing the material placed on record, it appears that the High Court had declared the acquisition proceedings in question as lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.

sentences.text: Reported in (2020) 8 SCC 129, the matter is required to be remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration.

4. In that view of the matter, the impugned order passed by the High Court is set aside and the matter is remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration in the light of the Judgment in the case of Indore Development Authority (supra).
5. It is clarified that all legal contentions are kept open to be raised by both the parties, as may be permissible.
6. The appeal stands allowed in above-terms.
